decisions.reason: Per-location reporting placement does not change the already established per-location payment-processing placement or payment setup.
The candidate already establishes a separate Wix account for each location; placing reporting in those accounts does not change that account model.
The separate-location website model is already established and remains valid unchanged by the reporting-placement detail.
Location-specific reporting does not alter the candidate's separate-payout rule or payout setup.
The reporting-placement change does not modify the independently established calendar isolation or calendar placement.
Per-location reporting does not change the candidate's booking isolation or booking placement.
Reporting through location-specific Wix accounts does not change how visitors discover locations or are routed from the master website.
The reporting-placement detail does not change the legacy site's transition availability or its master-site linkage.
Location-specific reporting is unrelated to preserving SEO elements and rankings during migration.
The reporting-placement decision does not change the established master website domain or domain routing.
Per-location reporting is compatible with the expansion strategy but does not necessarily modify its expansion capability or template strategy.
The reporting-placement decision does not affect the visual layout, navigation style, or competitor design reference.
